name: autarc
what: All-in-one planning, quoting and field software (with AI and LiDAR capture) for heat-pump and solar installers.

membership.basis: Live visionaries.vc portfolio; the founders state their seed round closed with Visionaries Club.
membership.quote: haben wir unsere Seed-Runde mit Visionaries Club erfolgreich abgeschlossen

entry.quote: Ende 2025 haben wir unsere Seed-Runde mit Visionaries Club erfolgreich abgeschlossen

graduation_surfaces: googlenews: "Autarc" raises / seed -> only the Dec 2023 pre-seed
websearch: autarc seed round Visionaries Club 2025 -> only the pv magazine founder piece (2025-03-18) and vendor profiles
notes: DATE CAVEAT: the founders' piece in pv magazine is dated 2025-03-18 yet says 'Ende 2025' the seed closed with Visionaries Club; a March 2025 article cannot report a late-2025 close, so this is read as end of 2024 (consistent with autarc first appearing on the Visionaries portfolio in the April 2025 capture). Entry date therefore 2024-12 (approximate); amount and lead not published (the same piece says the pre-seed was about EUR 1M, led by PT1). YC S24 (pv magazine: 'Als Teil des Y Combinator Batch S24'); the YC sibling row carries it as a Pre-Seed programme entry. Founded 2023 in Berlin by Etienne-Noel Krause and Thies Hansen (company site); imprint: Berlin, HRB 249005 B. Focus: the company sells planning/quoting software for installers ('The all-in-one software for companies that design & install heat pumps and solar panels', site title); I read that as SaaS, while the YC sibling row has AI & Applied AI (AI is a feature, not the product) and Climate & Energy is a defensible alternative; judge's call.
